snippet.title: Warnament Steam Release Date Trailer - v1.0 Available on August 7
snippet.description:
Wishlist Warnament on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1201700/Warnament/

Warnament is a turn-based grand strategy game, simple for newbies yet challenging for masters. As the leader of a nation, you will conquer territories and advance in military, technology, culture, or politics. Choose from historical scenarios or create your own with an editor.

Join the community: https://discord.gg/WwfsH8mnuz
Follow us on X/Twitter: https://x.com/warnamentgame
